cards.snippet: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ,…

cards.card_text: The writer says, "Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him." REMAINS, friend, not grabbing one cookie and hollering "Can't stay long!" from the doorway, and the writer tells us how we can know God remains in us.
cards.verse_text: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him.
cards.snippet: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him.

cards.card_text: A commandment from Him A custom from the elders A saying from Solomon
cards.verse_text: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
cards.snippet: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.

cards.card_text: When we love God and keep His commandments When we never argue with one another When we give away all we own
cards.verse_text: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.
cards.snippet: …love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.

cards.card_text: Loving God, the writer says, means keeping His commandments.
cards.verse_text: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments.
cards.snippet: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments.

cards.card_text: True or false: The writer says God's commandments are a heavy burden.
cards.verse_text: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments.
cards.snippet: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments.

cards.card_text: Then the elder turns to the dear lady and urges her to keep a commandment.
cards.verse_text: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
cards.snippet: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love…

cards.card_text: Which commandment does the elder urge the dear lady to keep?
cards.verse_text: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
cards.snippet: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love…

cards.card_text: The elder calls the commandment to love one another a brand new commandment.
cards.verse_text: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
cards.snippet: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love…

cards.card_text: He says love means walking according to His commandments.
cards.verse_text: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments.
cards.snippet: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments.

cards.card_text: And the commandment they've heard from the beginning?
cards.verse_text: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments.
cards.snippet: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments.

cards.card_text: They're the ones who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus.
cards.verse_text: And the dragon was enraged at the woman and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus.
cards.snippet: …to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus.

cards.card_text: Right after that warning, John writes a short line for the saints, the ones who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
cards.verse_text: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints, who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
cards.snippet: …is a call for the perseverance of the saints, who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
